_note: Reader lens, round 3, carousel no. 71, returned by carousel-scorer and saved in shape. Its hard fail was repaired before ship.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold register; 4, 6 and 2 pass; 7's planks and curb band, 8's blank boards, mannequin figures, 1's grey rail band.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Two working continuity devices and one light; 7's mid-tone floor sits outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Counts trace. The 'In September' month is unsourced (hard fail); the caption drops 'approximately' and counts notices for owners; slide 3's trays infer the reviewer's choices.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Useful to a notice holder; no next date, the October briefing unmentioned, nothing newer than September.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover describes rather than hooks; 3 to 5 at one tempo; a soft close.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific and local; attribution chains read as a sourcing ledger.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Same lastLight staging and close-hardware opener as recent decks; same item as no. 31.

hard_fails: Slide 8's dek and the caption dated Chad West's withdrawal 'In September', and no claim supplies the month (c56 says only 'previously'). Repaired before ship: the month is struck from both surfaces.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Three blank boards carry no information.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One contract binder with three year tabs and a termination slip.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin with a placard notice.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop to hands and the notice under the lamp.
